story.title: Jamtara Is Old News: How AI-Powered Synthetic Identity Fraud Is Now Threatening India's Digital Lenders
story.summary: As India's digital lending sector scales rapidly, AI-powered synthetic identity fraud has emerged as a structural threat to the underwriting models that lenders rely upon, according to a YourStory analysis. Fraudsters are now using generative AI to construct convincing fake identities — combining real and fabricated personal data — that pass conventional KYC and credit scoring checks, forcing lenders to rethink risk assessment from the ground up. The piece argues that fraud is no longer a downstream compliance problem but has become an upstream design challenge embedded in how digital credit is originated in India.
